elements.note: Only enlarged footing in the plan -- the most heavily loaded interior column. Drawn visibly larger than the 11 others.

warnings: FOOTING MARK = SIZE, not a schedule key: '(F1.30x1.30)' prints the pad plan size in metres directly. Enlargement details are on S-05 (F1.30x1.30 and F1.60x1.60, 1:20) -- Stage 2 joins the rebar there.
Full 3 x 4 layout: all 12 grid intersections carry a footing, 11 x F1.30x1.30 + 1 x F1.60x1.60 at C-2. Every column is C1 (single ตอม่อ mark in the whole plan; 0.20x0.20 per the S-05 section).

This sheet offers TWO ALTERNATE foundation systems for the same footprint: this view (spread footings) and the sibling view แปลนฐานรากแบบตอกเข็ม (driven piles, F5/F9) -- see _หน้า19_view2_footing_plan_pile.json. They are alternatives, not two storeys: quantities must never be summed across the two views. The BOQ block confirms this by pricing them as separate books (แบบฐานรากแผ่ printed pp. 38-47 vs แบบฐานรากเสาเข็ม pp. 48-57).
No dummy-grid point carries any footing in either view -- the 3'/A' extension frames bear on beams (see the grid master warnings).
No drawing break lines on this sheet; both dimension chains close (4.00+3.00=7.00, 4.00+2.00+3.50=9.50) -- verified in the grid master.
